messages:
emily: Hey folks — I'm drafting a compact 429 runbook for the Troubleshooting section. Goal: super short, copy-pasteable examples for curl + Python SDK + node, a tiny migration note for SDK v0.11, and one-line guidance for context limits and fallback behavior. Can anyone volunteer to drop snippets? :pray:
sam: I can do a python retry snippet. Keep it minimal and explain jitter/backoff in one line.
matt: I'll add the curl + streaming example and a note about watching `Retry-After` vs body-based rate hints.
irene: I'll scan docs for any old links to the rate-limit policy. Found one in /guides/limits that needs updating.
emily: awesome — for the SDK migration note we need to call out the param rename `max_context` -> `context_limit` in v0.11 and the new `auto_trim` behaviour. Just one short example and a migration command.
sam: Python snippet draft: ```python
# minimal 429 retry with exponential backoff + jitter
import time, random
for attempt in range(5):
    resp = client.generate(...)
    if resp.status_code == 429:
        wait = (2 ** attempt) * 0.5 + random.uniform(0, 0.3)
        time.sleep(wait)
        continue
    break
```
Add a note: prefer SDK's built-in `retry_policy` in prod.
matt: curl + streaming example: ```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"model":"xlarge","prompt":"..."}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# if you get 429 check headers: Retry-After or X-Rate-Limit-Reset
```
emily: Good — add one line about fallbacks: if sustained 429s, route to a cheaper variant (e.g., xlarge -> large) or enable cached prefixes.
irene: Link fix — the /guides/limits page currently points to an old RFC. I'll replace with https://redwood.ai/docs/limits and add an anchor to `#too-many-requests`.
docs-bot: FYI: There's an open docs PR #412 that modifies the Troubleshooting TOC, might conflict with this runbook.
emily: Thanks, docs-bot. I'll rebase against #412 after snippets land. Targeting small PR: `docs/429-runbook-compact`.
matt: Quick wording suggestion for the runbook: start with a 2-sentence summary, then 3 actionable items (binary: retry, fallback, contact support) with tiny snippets. Avoid long theory.
sam: Also include a one-liner about context windows: "If prompt >> model context, trim older history or use embeddings for retrieval." Maybe a code hint: `client.trim_context(prompt, limit=2048)`.
emily: Perfect. For SDK migration note (v0.11): one-line example: ```python
# v0.10
resp = client.generate(prompt, max_context=4096)
# v0.11
resp = client.generate(prompt, context_limit=4096, auto_trim=True)
```
emily: Can someone volunteer to open the PR with those snippets + link fix? I'll review and add the final checklist.
irene: I'll open the PR in ~30m, include a changelog entry and the anchor link fix.
matt: I'll add the curl example + a note about 502/503 behavior: treat transient 5xx like backoff + failover to different region. One-line.
sam: Small nit: show use of `Retry-After` header parsing in python: ```python
retry_after = int(resp.headers.get('Retry-After', 0))
if retry_after:
    time.sleep(retry_after)
```
emily: Great. Let's keep thread small. PR title: "docs: compact 429 runbook + migration snippets". Aim to merge today if no conflicts. :tada:
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled for docs site in ~10m. If PR lands before that, it will go out with the next deploy.
emire: (typo) ignore
emily: haha noted. Thanks all — will review PR once it's up and then we can close this thread. :thumbsup:
